definition.description: Travel forward on a clear level lane through deliberate alternating no-flight march steps. At each exchange, one thigh lifts toward the declared landmark while the opposite foot supports; the next foot returns close beneath the body, then sides exchange with reciprocal arm action. One cycle is one controlled step on each side. This excludes flight, skipping, running, wall support, resistance, overhead reaching, a projection transition, obstacle work, and assessment.
